describes: packages/plugin/search: the session-free findAll service and its abort signal.

cases.name: find-all-walks-the-chain
cases.covers: findAll() walks the cursor chain in natural page order (no startPage, even with a Stage) and resolves every hit, dispatching nothing and leaving the session untouched.

cases.name: find-all-pinned-mode
cases.covers: An explicit mode is sent as is and never degrades: a pinned 'full' refused rejects with the refusal.

cases.name: find-all-degrades
cases.covers: With no mode, findAll degrades 'full' to 'rects' on a refusal, as the session does.

cases.name: find-all-restart-resets
cases.covers: A stale cursor restarts findAll once and drops what the first pass had collected.

cases.name: find-all-errors-reject
cases.covers: An engine error rejects findAll with its PluginError; a page with userUnit 0 still converts.

cases.name: find-all-is-independent-of-the-session
cases.covers: A findAll running beside the session neither supersedes it nor is superseded by it; both complete.

cases.name: find-all-signal-aborts-the-slice
cases.covers: Aborting findAll's signal aborts the in-flight slice with the signal's reason and rejects with it: the platform AbortError with no reason, the given error with one.

cases.name: find-all-signal-already-aborted
cases.covers: A signal aborted before the call still sends the first request; when it lands, findAll rejects with the reason.

cases.name: find-all-signal-after-resolution
cases.covers: Aborting after findAll resolved does nothing: the listener was removed and no slice is in flight.

cases.name: find-all-signal-on-an-error
cases.covers: A signal that never aborts leaves an engine error to reject findAll; aborting afterwards does nothing.
